title: Demos
h5Description: Demonstrates mobile adaptation from a 750px design in an isolated document
h5IsolationNote: The preview runs in an isolated iframe, so its viewport and root font size do not affect the admin app.
parallaxDescription: A three-layer parallax demo driven straight by scroll progress: depth layering, differential motion and a pinned reveal
parallaxHeroSubtitle: Background, midground and foreground travel at different speeds, stacking three velocity layers into a single scroll.
parallaxDifferentialDescription: The image and the copy share one scroll progress but map it onto different offset ranges, which is what pulls them apart in depth.
parallaxPinTitle: The frame holds, the story moves
parallaxStep1Description: Background, midground and foreground share one screen, and the speed gap creates the illusion of depth.
parallaxStep2Description: One scroll progress mapped onto different offset ranges layers the image and the copy naturally.
parallaxStep3Description: The viewport pins to a fixed frame while the content fades in and out along scroll progress.
parallaxReducedMotion: Your system asks for reduced motion, so this page fell back to a static layout.
parallaxOutroDescription: Every offset is computed from scroll progress directly, with no animation library involved.
